name: color-picker-basic
code:
import {ColorArea, ColorPicker, ColorSlider, ColorSwatch, Label} from "@lenso/ui";

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <ColorPicker defaultValue="#0485F7">
      <ColorPicker.Trigger>
        <ColorSwatch size="lg" />
        <Label>选择颜色</Label>
      </ColorPicker.Trigger>
      <ColorPicker.Popover>
        <ColorArea
          aria-label="取色区域"
          className="max-w-full"
          colorSpace="hsb"
          xChannel="saturation"
          yChannel="brightness"
        >
          <ColorArea.Thumb />
        </ColorArea>
        <ColorSlider channel="hue" className="gap-1 px-1" colorSpace="hsb">
          <Label>色相</Label>
          <ColorSlider.Output className="text-muted" />
          <ColorSlider.Track>
            <ColorSlider.Thumb />
          </ColorSlider.Track>
        </ColorSlider>
      </ColorPicker.Popover>
    </ColorPicker>
  );
}
